items.title: Von Freeman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He was around, but I don’t really remember his band too well. I think he was a little bit before my time.

ctx.x: Was Fletcher Henderson around then? Or that gig was finished?
He was around, but I don’t really remember his band too well. I think he was a little bit before my time.
Because I know that Benny Goodman stole – stole? – borrowed his arranger.
